answer: Sybil resistance arises because each identity must complete a Wesolowski VDF based on a long chain of sequential modular squarings, where every result depends on the previous one. An attacker may create many clones, but GPUs cannot substantially shorten any individual chain through parallelism; they only multiply concurrent resource demands. The enforced delay forms a physical time bottleneck, with delta, ridge, and violet serving as distinct instance parameters.
